environment: Isolated local Northgate API with current production web build
method: CUA browser interaction, accessibility tree and screenshots

checks.flow: Open case panel receives independent API state transition over SSE without a browser refresh
Source evidence and back-to-case focus return
Manager approval with a required note
Reject repair with evidence and enter warranty review
Record community action completion then verify its outcome
Community outcome excludes maintenance verification buttons after fix
Unsaved permission limit survives refresh; explicit save succeeds
Resident has cases and personal invitations without management navigation or quotes
Resident meeting availability persists and becomes Update availability
Personal clarification answer removes only the completed response card
Escape closes case panel and restores initiating Review case button focus

limitations: These actions used an isolated fixture with deterministic model ports and simulated delivery.
This is a targeted browser check, not an independent usability study or a complete screen-reader/automated accessibility certification.
Cognito hosted sign-in was checked separately against the real AWS application.
